notes: Both heaven-phrases in the verse give the ASV no determiner, so the genitive article is unrepresented under rules 21 and 23 and of rides with the noun.
τῷ Ἰησοῦ: article before a name with no English determiner is unrepresented (rule 23), and the dative preposition unto stays with the name under rule 21's determinerless clause.
